reason: I already have my naengmyeon place and I go there whenever it's hot. Nothing here tells me this bowl is better than the one I already trust, and $18.95 plus tax is more than I like to pay for noodles.
objection: Korean food is everywhere in Honolulu. Arrowroot noodles sound interesting, but every place says theirs is special. Why would I leave my regular spot for this one?
would_change_my_mind: A friend or someone in the Korean community I trust telling me their chik naengmyeon broth is the real thing, better than my usual place.
